prompt: A production checkout rollout completed 12 minutes ago. User-visible 5xx rose from 0.4% to 27%, p95 latency doubled, and two responders are independently changing feature flags while another is investigating the database. Operate the production incident from the supplied timeline and controls: declare severity from explicit impact, establish incident command plus operations/comms/scribe ownership, freeze uncoordinated mutations, preserve the rollout/configuration and telemetry evidence, choose and execute one reversible mitigation, publish a factual stakeholder update with a next-update trigger/cadence, then verify recovery using user error/latency, representative checkout transactions, dependency health, and the rollback state. Keep an observation window long enough to catch the supplied recurrence pattern and hand off any temporary configuration divergence and follow-up owners before closing.

requirements: live synthetic checkout outage with timestamped telemetry and recent rollout history
reversible rollout and feature-flag controls with audit log
stakeholder communication channel fixture and incident timeline document

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The response records declaration/severity and assigns a single IC plus explicit operations, communications, and timeline ownership before additional production mutations occur.
Uncoordinated mutations are stopped, the chosen mitigation has one owner and a documented undo path, and the incident log records its start time, intended effect, and observed result.
The rollout/configuration state and relevant telemetry/log evidence are preserved before rollback or restart so the response does not erase the only available pre-mitigation state.
The stakeholder update states impact, current mitigation/status, known unknowns, and a next update time or event without presenting an unproven root cause as fact.
Resolution requires recovery of user 5xx/latency plus successful representative checkout probes and dependency/rollback-state checks through the configured recurrence observation window.
Closure records residual risk, any temporary configuration divergence, watch items, and named owners for follow-up work with timestamps in the incident record.
